1	# Change context (parent-prepared, factual record)
2	
3	## Intent and authority (explicit)
4	- README.md (repo root): "The existing GET /settings response and routing behavior remain the
5	  acceptance contract. Export preview activation belongs to a later task; this increment must
6	  remain independently compatible while that task is pending. The checked-in build setting is
7	  fixed at False; it is not supplied by a request, environment variable or external config.
8	  No deployment inventory is maintained in this small source repository."
9	- tasks.md Task 1 (status: in-progress; user states this staged diff is Task 1):
10	  "Preserve existing routes with preview disabled in the checked-in build." /
11	  "Add the preview module and guarded route for the next increment."
12	- tasks.md Task 2 (pending, depends on Task 1): "Implement render_preview and its enabled-path
13	  tests before changing the build setting."
14	
15	## Change boundary
16	- Selector: staged changes (`git diff --cached`); no unstaged changes exist.
17	- Candidate: Git index. Worktree copies of preview.py and routes.py equal the index (no unstaged diff).
18	- Review base: HEAD f1a16b5 ("Review base").
19	- Changed: preview.py (added), routes.py (modified). Unchanged but relevant: config.py
20	  (EXPORT_PREVIEW_ENABLED = False, tracked at base), settings.py, tests/test_routes.py.
21	- Deliberately pending: render_preview implementation, enabled-path tests, flipping the flag (Task 2).
22	
23	## Existing behavior to preserve
24	- routes.get("/settings") -> (200, current_settings()) == (200, {"theme": "light"})
25	- routes.get(<any other path>) -> (404, None), including "/export-preview" while disabled.
26	
27	## Delivery constraints
28	- Python 3.9+, stdlib only. Independently compatible increment; flag fixed False in source.
29	
30	## Baselines
31	- Review base: f1a16b5. No released/deployed baseline exists in this repo (README: no deployment
32	  inventory). Release comparison: Not applicable / Unknown beyond source.
33	
34	## Scenarios and evidence
35	- Parent executed `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v` at the candidate worktree
36	  (equal to index): 3 tests ran, all OK (test_current_settings, test_preview_route,
37	  test_unknown_route). This is parent-attributed execution; reviewers have source-only access.
38	- No test exercises EXPORT_PREVIEW_ENABLED=True (pending Task 2 by design).
39	
40	## Rejected approaches
41	- None recorded.
42
